saying: Most commenters accept periodic re-benchmarking, sample-based clinician review, and degradation monitoring as complementary but too narrow, urging monitoring of overrides, near misses, subgroup and workflow effects, human-AI team performance, and clinical outcomes. Many ask that reassessment be event-triggered (model, prompt, retrieval, population, or safety-signal changes) alongside a calendar floor, and that version and configuration records be reconstructable.

disagreement.text: Commenters split on cadence: some would drop fixed intervals and re-benchmark only on defined events, while others want a default risk-tiered periodic schedule (quarterly to annual) or an annual calendar floor with out-of-cycle triggers layered on top.

sides.summary: Reassessment should be event- or trigger-driven rather than on a fixed periodic schedule.
Keep a scheduled baseline cadence set by risk (or an annual floor), with event triggers added.
